Current preparation checks all plan artifacts and every exact source_owner_pins entry before copying source files.

custody: opening/closing saved file byte equality only; no continuous endpoint custody or current remote state attestation

findings.observation: CommitOperationAdd receives mutable path strings. The inspected installed SDK reopens path inputs while uploading/preparing payloads, after the local review hash check. Use a checked immutable byte snapshot or equivalent stable file custody and revalidate closure immediately before commit.

read() uses default json.loads, which accepts duplicate keys and nonfinite JSON. Receipt/review/input schemas are not closed. Add strict parsing and explicit closed metadata schemas so ambiguous declarations cannot override reviewed fields.

The publisher checks payload file count but does not check declared/reviewed payload byte totals against all entry sizes or a bounded payload contract. Future concrete publication must check both totals and ordinary normalized entry paths.

The created commit is durably saved before remote identity assertions, but the fetched immutable after-identities map is not saved before an automatic attribute-change refusal. Save that map/diff before assertions to preserve the exact refusal evidence.
